rows.grounds: past participle of prac (to proclaim), masculine nominative singular; sandhi final -ḥ becomes -o before vāsudevo
nominative singular of vāsudeva; sandhi final -aḥ becomes -o before manīṣibhiḥ
instrumental plural of manīṣin (wise one), indicating agency

items.question: Which deity is identified with the twelve-syllable Gāyatrī mantra proclaimed by the wise?
premises: Wise men proclaim it as Vāsudeva.
items.inference: The twelve-syllable Gāyatrī mantra is identified with Vāsudeva.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of prokto between mantra and Vāsudeva remains slightly open.
items.plain_english: The wise proclaim this twelve-syllable mantra as Vāsudeva.
